page_title: CAG 1-2 TOR | Cagliari v Torino 26/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Cagliari will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+5' Ivan Juric appears to have said too much and referee Andrea Colombo comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90+4' The goal by Torino is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
90+3' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Torino players aren’t happy.
90+2' Goal! Mergim Vojvoda feeds Pietro Pellegri (Torino), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:3.

90+1' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Ricardo Rodriguez (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Andrea Colombo and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) replaces Raoul Bellanova.
87' Here is a change. Duvan Zapata is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Pietro Pellegri (Torino).
86' Cagliari take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
82' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) gets booked.
78' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Antonio Sanabria and he is replaced by Saba Sazonov (Torino).
77' 1 - 2 Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the left post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' The substitution has been made. Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) has replaced Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi.
71' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) replacing Nahitan Nandez.
69' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
68' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

68' What a great chance for Alberto Dossena (Cagliari). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Cagliari.
67' The referee signals a corner kick to Cagliari.
65' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Simone Scuffet makes a simple save.
65' The ball is cleared after Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
63' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) will replace Samuele Ricci.
62' Booking. Samuele Ricci (Torino) receives a caution from the referee.
57' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
53' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
52' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari. The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
50' Duvan Zapata (Torino) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save.
46' Claudio Ranieri makes a switch. Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is coming on in place of Pantelis Hatzidiakos at the start of the second period.
46' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) comes on the pitch for Jakub Jankto.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' 0 - 2 Samuele Ricci (Torino) scores a lucky goal from mid-range. Although his low shot was struck towards the middle of the goal, the goalkeeper was unable to reach the ball.
45+1' A pass by Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' The corner from Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) is intercepted by the defence.
42' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
41' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Mateusz Wieteska (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.

40' What a wasted opportunity by Duvan Zapata (Torino)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Simone Scuffet makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
38' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

36' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
35' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
30' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
29' A brilliant cross into the box finds Antonio Sanabria (Torino), who directs his header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
27' Half-chance! Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) plays a pass into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic reacts well to snuff out the attack.
26' Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Raoul Bellanova puts the ball on a plate for Duvan Zapata (Torino), who scores with a simple close-range finish. It's 0:1.
22' Duvan Zapata (Torino) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
19' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Torino was in an offside position.
19' Torino restart play with a quick free kick.
18' A player from Cagliari commits a rough challenge. Andrea Colombo blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Torino are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
16' Cagliari are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
11' Problems for Claudio Ranieri as Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Matteo Prati replaces him.
7' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
4' Andrea Colombo interrupts the game. One of the players from Torino won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
2' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Cagliari will kick the game off.
Andrea Colombo was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
